SELECT json_build_object(
  'safety_pathology_unresolved', coalesce((SELECT json_agg(t.*) FROM (
    SELECT pf.id::text AS finding_id, pf.pathology_type AS type, pf.severity, pf.description,
      p.id::text AS project_id, p.name AS project_name, p.current_phase
    FROM pathology_findings pf
    JOIN projects p ON p.id = pf.project_id
    WHERE pf.affects_safety = true
      AND pf.status NOT IN ('repaired', 'dismissed', 'monitored')
      AND p.current_phase NOT IN ('archived')
    LIMIT 20
  ) t), '[]'::json),
  'aftercare_urgent_open_24h', coalesce((SELECT json_agg(t.*) FROM (
    SELECT i.id::text AS incident_id, i.severity, i.category, i.responsible_trade,
      substring(i.description for 100) AS desc_preview, i.reported_at,
      floor(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (now() - i.reported_at))/3600)::int AS hours_open,
      p.id::text AS project_id, p.name AS project_name
    FROM aftercare_incidents i
    JOIN projects p ON p.id = i.project_id
    WHERE i.severity IN ('urgent', 'high')
      AND i.status NOT IN ('resolved', 'closed', 'disputed')
      AND i.reported_at < now() - INTERVAL '24 hours'
    LIMIT 20
  ) t), '[]'::json),
  'safety_unconfirmed_in_obra', coalesce((SELECT json_agg(t.*) FROM (
    SELECT p.id::text AS project_id, p.name AS project_name, p.current_phase
    FROM projects p
    WHERE p.current_phase IN ('approved', 'planning_done')
      AND p.status = 'active'
      AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM safety_plans sp WHERE sp.project_id = p.id AND sp.exec_status = 'confirmed')
    LIMIT 10
  ) t), '[]'::json),
  'no_encargo_in_obra', coalesce((SELECT json_agg(t.*) FROM (
    SELECT p.id::text AS project_id, p.name AS project_name, p.current_phase
    FROM projects p
    WHERE p.current_phase IN ('approved', 'planning_done')
      AND p.status = 'active'
      AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM contracts c WHERE c.project_id = p.id AND c.contract_type = 'encargo_profesional' AND c.status = 'signed')
    LIMIT 10
  ) t), '[]'::json),
  'total_critical', (
    (SELECT count(*) FROM pathology_findings pf JOIN projects p ON p.id = pf.project_id WHERE pf.affects_safety = true AND pf.status NOT IN ('repaired', 'dismissed', 'monitored') AND p.current_phase NOT IN ('archived'))
  + (SELECT count(*) FROM aftercare_incidents WHERE severity IN ('urgent','high') AND status NOT IN ('resolved','closed','disputed') AND reported_at < now() - INTERVAL '24 hours')
  + (SELECT count(*) FROM projects WHERE current_phase IN ('approved','planning_done') AND status='active' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM safety_plans sp WHERE sp.project_id = projects.id AND sp.exec_status = 'confirmed'))
  + (SELECT count(*) FROM projects WHERE current_phase IN ('approved','planning_done') AND status='active' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM contracts c WHERE c.project_id = projects.id AND c.contract_type = 'encargo_profesional' AND c.status = 'signed'))
  )::int
) AS report;
